purpose: Classify lineage contracts so historical schemas remain immutable evidence and only one lineage admission schema is current authority.

contracts.reason: Older lineage schema uses raw_sha256/semantic_sha256 naming. Preserve unchanged; do not treat it as current runtime authority.

authority_rule: Exactly one lineage contract may be CURRENT_AUTHORITY. Historical or superseded contracts remain immutable and cannot satisfy a current gate merely by existence.
validator_rule: tools/evidence_lineage_validator.py validates against CURRENT_AUTHORITY field semantics and may read legacy aliases only for backward-readable fixtures.
promotion_rule: Contract classification never grants promotion. Fresh gate-owned evidence is still required.
forensic_rule: Do not rewrite historical contracts to match the current schema. Add a new classification record instead.
